places-gorgany-grosii-tiblesului-preluci.story: A 311 km round trip from Bystrytsya - roughly 5 h 22 in the saddle. It goes by way of Svydovets, Kuziy - Trybushany, Church of Saint Nicholas and Groșii Țibleșului - Preluci. The highest point is about 1,050 m. It crosses from Ukraine into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
